chunks: Al-Sheikh (may Allah have mercy on him) informed me, from Abu al-Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from 'Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu 'Abd Allah (peace be upon him):

He said: When you intend to apply hanut to the deceased, go to the camphor and wipe with it the places of prostration on his body, all his joints, his head, his beard, and upon his chest from the hanut.
And he said: The hanut is the same for men and women.
He said: And I dislike that [the body] be followed by a censer.

key_terms.آثَارَ السُّجُودِ: places of prostration — forehead, nose, palms, knees, and toes
key_terms.الْحَنُوطِ: hanut — camphor-based preparation applied to the deceased during funeral rites

ai.seo_question: According to Imam al-Sadiq (AS), what are the correct places on the body to apply hanut (camphor) to the deceased?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) prescribes the ritual procedure for applying hanut (camphor-based embalming preparation) to the deceased: camphor is to be wiped on the places of prostration, all joints, the head, beard, and chest. The Imam rules that hanut is applied identically to men and women, and expresses ritual dislike (karahah) for following the funeral procession with a censer.
